digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — OpenAI Responses API readiness
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 constructs OpenAIResponsesModel for openai-responses: prefix and deprecates openai: in favor of Responses API by default in v2.0, but rebar's runner blocks openai-responses: at four code sites (config.py KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES, providers.py is_resolvable, capabilities.py _PROFILE_RESOLVERS, and openai:→openai-chat: normalizers) making it unusable despite pydantic-ai support.

Custom base_url endpoints (LMStudio/Ollama/vLLM) and gateway/openai cannot route to Responses API under the current pin because ProviderSession._build_openai and endpoint override are keyed only on openai/openai-chat names.

Third-party OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, Grok, xAI, Groq, Cerebras, Moonshot, Heroku) construct Chat-Completions-only models in pydantic-ai 1.107.2 with no Responses construction path for their vendor prefixes.

Contract tests in tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py parameterize assertions over openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes using real pydantic-ai model construction (not mocks) and an httpx MockTransport stub to verify structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry, and custom-base-URL routing behavior identically for both wire protocols.
All 12 parameterized contract test cases pass identically under both openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes, confirming behavioral compatibility at the pydantic-ai layer.

xai: and groq: endpoints cannot be classified under the current checkout because the xai-sdk and groq optional packages are not installed and not in rebar's extras, so vendor-side /v1/responses support for these endpoints is recorded as UNKNOWN.
